title: Butuan’s water supply recovers, but some taps remain dry

blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — The water level at the Taguibo Watershed dam has returned to normal following recent rainfall, boosting Butuan City’s total water supply to at least 60 million liters per day (MLD). However, several residents continued to report dry taps and intermittent water service on Sunday. The Butuan City Water District (BCWD) said in its 9 a.m. water supply advisory on Sept. 20 that production from the Taguibo watershed had reached 55.06 MLD, while BCWD’s pumping facilities contributed another 5.1 MLD.
